summary_en: The video captures a dragon dance competition inside an indoor arena, starting with a referee holding a red flag and introduction of the teams. Performers in uniforms execute undulating dragon dance movements, utilizing boat props and fake stone walls on a green mat. Following the performance, judges evaluate the routine, raise scorecards, and the head referee announces the final results via microphone. Finally, the broadcast screen displays the detailed scorecard for the team from Binh Thuan with a final score of 8.53.
